items.title: Dooza Desk – AI-native customer support for small teams (free pilots)
items.raw_excerpt:
I built Dooza Desk ( https://www.doozadesk.com ), a very early, AI native helpdesk for small teams. I’m looking for a few teams to run free pilots and tell me what breaks. Problem I’m aiming at:
- Small teams still type the same support answers that legacy tools can't close
- Most helpdesks are seat-priced, not work done or AI based like cursor
- “AI” in many tools is a thin layer on top of an old ticketing model, not the core. What Dooza Desk does right now (basic version):
- Simple shared omnichannel inbox for customer messages.
- AI can autonomously solve tickets and take actions (need some polish)
- Lightweight helpdesk features (assign, status, notes) so it can replace a bare inbox for small teams. High-level implementation details:
- Messages are normalized into a single internal tic

excerpt_i18n.en: On December 4, three days after its launch, Doubao Mobile Assistant issued a "Statement on Adjusting AI's Mobile Operation Capabilities," announcing plans to standardize adjustments to its AI mobile operation features in certain scenarios over the coming period. It emphasized active communication with all parties to promote clearer, more predictable rules, avoiding a one-size-fits-all approach that denies users reasonable rights to use AI. As a new product, the preview version of Doubao Mobile Assistant garnered widespread social attention after its launch. Official videos showcased its capabilities in helping users order takeout, book flights, compare prices for shopping, and even reply to WeChat messages or operate mini-program games. However, after the official launch, multiple users reported restrictions on logging into third-party products like WeChat when using the "mobile operation feature." Rumors later circulated that Doubao Mobile Assistant accessed system capabilities without authorization. In response, Doubao Mobile Assistant clarified that AI mobile operations require explicit user authorization, and users can interrupt tasks at any time. Sensitive authorizations during third-party app operations require secondary manual confirmation by users. Nevertheless, some controversies persist, arguing that user data authorization cannot substitute for third-party platform authorization. "It can act as a messenger, coordinator, feedback mechanism, and linkage across various apps and intelligent agents, greatly facilitating user experience and improving efficiency," said Lü Peng, Deputy Director of the Wuhan Institute for Artificial Intelligence at Peking University. "Serving humanity with technology is the baseline," he added, "and humans should not be deprived of the use of..."

También enfatizó que se comunicará activamente con todas las partes, con la esperanza de promover la formación de reglas más claras y predecibles, evitando negar el derecho de los usuarios a utilizar razonablemente la IA de manera uniforme. Como algo nuevo, la versión preliminar de Doubao Asistente Móvil ha generado una amplia atención social tras su lanzamiento. En el video oficial, la versión preliminar de Doubao Asistente Móvil demostró su capacidad para ayudar a los usuarios a pedir comida a domicilio, reservar billetes de avión, comparar precios al comprar e incluso responder mensajes de WeChat.

excerpt_i18n.en: As generative AI fully enters the three-dimensional space, enabling machines not only to "see" objects but also to understand their structures, joints, and motion patterns has become a key focus for global research institutions and industries. From virtual content creation to robotic manipulation, and from digital twins to industrial simulation, the automated generation of movable 3D objects is regarded as a crucial foundational capability for future interactive digital worlds. However, existing methods are still largely constrained by reliance on complete 3D scans, inconsistencies arising from separate modeling of structure and texture, and difficulties in handling visibility changes caused by motion. In this context, a recent study by the S-Lab team at Nanyang Technological University offers a new solution. Their proposed unified modeling framework can generate movable 3D objects with realistic geometric structures, accurate joint parameters, and natural appearance textures from a single image, achieving significant improvements in geometric accuracy, appearance consistency, and motion plausibility. This work not only demonstrates the synergistic potential of structured latent spaces, diffusion-based 3D generation, and joint-aware texture modeling but also lays the groundwork for enhancing AI's understanding of object functionality and interactive attributes. Notably, one of the paper's authors, Pan Xingang, was an invited guest at the 2023 GAIR Global Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Conference, where he discussed cutting-edge directions in 3D vision, robotic manipulation, and generative models alongside researchers from top international institutions and companies. ByteDance VP Li Liang: Doubao Mobile Assistant operates with user authorization, no "invasion" or "overreach"
